B0BNHQJ95L.title: SwitchBot Smart Electric Motorized Blinds Kit - 3Pack with 2.4G WiFi Remote Control, Solar Powered, Compatible with Alexa, Google Home and Siri, Light Sensing Control, Unlimited Group Control
bullets: Makes Retrofitting Blinds Easy: SwitchBot Blind Tilt removes the need to replace existing louvers, and with simple installation, you can make your blinds smart instantly. This pack includes 3 Blind Tilts and a SwitchBot Hub Mini, great for any home.
Endless Solar Battery Life: Our smart blinds feature a built-in 2000mAh lithium battery, and includes a solar panel for endless environmentally-friendly charging.

Control via Groups: When in Bluetooth range you can control up to 4 units of blinds with one button through our app, and can set unlimited groups when used together with SwitchBot Hub Mini (Included).

Wide Range of Control: Use our app to control your blind tilts whenever you want whilst at home. And when paired with SwitchBot Hub Mini you'll be able to use third-party smart assistants such as Alexa, Google Home and Siri and control remotely even when you're outside of the house.

Precise Adjustment Control: SwitchBot Blind Tilt includes a built-in light sensor to automatically adjust to help you maintain constant light intensity and uses a customized high-precision motor to allow for blind adjustments to the closest 2°.
SwitchBot Blind Tilt is designed for horizontal blinds with a pole, including poles with diameters of 6.2 mm to 10.2 mm & 12 mm. It is not compatible with vertical blinds.

B0FX9BVZNW.title: Remac M1 Motorized Smart Electric Curtain Track with Remote 66"-114"
bullets: 【No-Cut Fit for 49"–87" Window Openings】Size L fits window openings over 49" and up to 87" wide. Simply measure the width of your window opening from inside edge to inside edge. If your measurement falls within this range, choose Size L. When adjusted to the recommended length, the track extends approximately 13.5" beyond each side of the window opening for better curtain coverage. No cutting or splicing required. Designed for center-opening hook-style or pinch-pleat curtains only. Not compatible with one-way opening, S-fold/wave-fold, grommet, rod-pocket, or decorative rods. Curtains not included. Includes 28 carrier hooks (14 per side).

【Motorized Curtain Track with Remote, App & Voice】 Open, close, or stop your curtains without pulling heavy fabric. Use the included remote from bed, control from the app on the sofa, or use voice control through Apple Home, Alexa, or Google Home. Set morning wake-up schedules, evening privacy routines, or away-time schedules so your curtains move automatically around your day. Designed for center-opening curtains only.

【Works with Apple Home + Matter over Wi-Fi】 M1 is Apple Home Certified and carries the Works with Apple Home badge. Scan the Matter code to add it to Apple Home, Alexa, or Google Home—no extra hub required. Supports app, voice, schedules, scenes, Pull-to-Start, and manual control. Requires 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.

【No-Cut Telescopic Curtain Rail Track】 Skip the saw, metal cutting, and custom track ordering. The telescopic aluminum rail extends to fit the listed size range, then locks in place for a clean motorized curtain setup. No cutting or track splicing required. Basic installation tools and drilling are still needed; install into concrete, wood studs, or properly reinforced mounting points. Two-person installation is recommended for longer sizes.

【Track for Blackout Drapes】 Built for daily use in bedrooms, living rooms, patio doors, and wide windows. The compact mini motor stays tucked beside the drape for a clean, modern look, while the aluminum track moves finished curtains up to 66 lb / 30 kg. Motor noise is rated at 35 dB; full system noise is rated at 45 dB which is quiet. Use it as a ceiling mount curtain track or wall-mounted motorized curtain track to fit different window layouts. 【Installation& Warranty】Ceiling mount and Wall mount is suitable for track.Motor is covered for 5 year warranty; the complete system is covered for 3 years warranty.

B0H6ZQ6WVN.title: Aura SmartShade Motor for Beaded-Chain Roller Shades, WiFi Dongle Included
B0H6ZQ6WVN.byline: Visit the AURA SMART HOME Store
bullets: CHECK YOUR SHADE FIRST: Fits roller and zebra shades that use a continuous looped plastic or metal beaded chain, up to 3 kg (6.6 lb) or about 4 x 5 ft. Also tilts vertical blinds that use a beaded chain. Not for cordless shades, wand-operated or horizontal slat blinds, or curtains. Motor only; the shade is not included.

INSTALL IN ABOUT 15–30 MINUTES: Choose the sprocket that matches your bead size (several sizes included) and loop the chain in. Pull the chain straight down and taut, then mount the bracket with the included adhesive pad: clean the spot, press firmly for 30 seconds, and wait 24 hours before first use.
WIFI DONGLE INCLUDED – KEEP IT PLUGGED IN: The included USB WiFi dongle links SmartShade to your 2.4 GHz WiFi, the Smart Life app, Alexa and Google Home. No hub required and no subscription needed.
CONTROL IT 3 WAYS: Use the included remote, the buttons on the device, or the app. Set schedules and exact open percentages in the app.
UP TO 2 MONTHS PER CHARGE: Rated at one full up-and-down cycle per day on a standard shade; heavier shades and more cycles shorten it. Charge fully before first use.

【𝐁𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫】This motor operates with a power cable and requires a 110V power supply. It does not support charging. With a robust force of 1.2N, it effortlessly lifts blinds up to 120 inches and can handle a maximum weight of 12 pounds.

【𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬】This Roller Shade Motor supports limit adjustment, suitable for windows of any height. It has built-in 2.4G WiFi and a built-in 433MHz remote control receiver, enabling timed control.
